text.card: A red giant 6,217 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.86 solar masses and 12.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,657 K at its surface.
